A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CaKE research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–C. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, figures, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original circuit-analysis and intervention results, CaKE benchmark evaluations, and efficiency and multiple-edit experiments (Table 1, Figure 3, Tables 2–4 and 8–9).

after.justification: v3 retains original circuit-analysis, intervention, benchmark, efficiency, and multiple-edit results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 retains the same circuit-aware data generation, two task categories, LoRA training procedure, and cross-entropy objective. Appendix B implementation descriptions are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use HoppingTooLate, the same three MQuAKE variants, and CommonsenseQA, BBH, MMLU, and GSM8k. The appendix shortcut and multiple-edit scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main evaluations (Tables 2–3), locality comparison (Table 4), and appendix comparisons (Tables 7–9). No comparison method is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: The model configurations, data selection, H-Acc and MAcc definitions, answer-matching procedure, training settings, and appendix evaluation procedures are identical.

E4.justification: The circuit interventions, hop/position analyses, logit and rank case studies, shortcut test, and multiple-edit analysis are retained unchanged (Figures 3–6; Appendices B.3 and C).

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point estimates and averages. Neither adds repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries, plotted findings, and qualitative outcomes are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 retains CaKE's LLAMA3-8B multi-hop accuracies of 57.3, 57.1, and 81.4 across the three MQuAKE variants.

T1.justification: Equations 1–5 and their mathematical reasoning remain unchanged, including the reasoning composition, editing gate formulations, and training objective. No definitions, assumptions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about circuit-aware knowledge integration, multi-hop generalization, memory efficiency, and scalability.

C2.justification: The weak-signal and propagation-failure explanations, result interpretations, and appendix discussions are unchanged. The limitations concerning reasoning domains, reasoning patterns, circuit components, and data attribution are also retained verbatim.

D1.justification: Appendices A–C retain the same generation prompts, hardware disclosures, LoRA hyperparameters, baseline implementation details, and efficiency-measurement procedure. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are identical. References move across columns and pages, but no bibliographic work or substantive relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: The acknowledgements add 'Zhejiang University' after 'State Key Lab of CAD&CG', and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. All remaining wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement addition accompanies spacing changes on page 9, continuation onto page 10, and reflow of references across pages 10–13. All figures, tables, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 clarifies an institutional acknowledgement and updates the version stamp, with limited accompanying layout changes. The complete scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged, so these editorial adjustments do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
